title: fix(plugin-dashboard): "Custom…" reopens a stored date range, and the calendar stays open (objectui#10843)
body:
Fixes #10843
Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat #1 (claim 5860209758, triage 5859999481). This run's session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`. Patch round 1 answers contract review 5860744504 (FAIL on `51d262441`): it restores the closed trigger's type-ahead path, which the first round had dropped (see "Patch round 1").

## What was wrong (two defects, not one)

The card named one defect. A real browser shows two, and the second one breaks the path the ruling names as the control.

1. **A stored custom range cannot be reopened.** With a custom range stored, the `dateRange` select's value already is the 「Custom…」 item (`CUSTOM_VALUE`). Radix controllable state (`@radix-ui/react-use-controllable-state` 1.2.6) calls `onChange` only for a changed value, so `onValueChange` never ran and `setCustomOpen(true)` was never reached.
2. **From a preset, picking 「Custom…」 from the list dismisses the calendar as soon as it opens.** The pick opened the popover during the select's own close. Once the list finished its exit animation and unmounted, its focus scope handed focus back to the select trigger. Focus leaving the already-open popover dismissed it. The card saw this in happy-dom and marked it as not measured in a real browser. Chromium shows the same thing (table below).

## How Radix picks 「Custom…」: three paths, with no `onSelect`

- **In-list pointer or key.** This is `handleSelect`, reached from the item's `onPointerUp` (mouse), `onClick` (touch and pen) and `onKeyDown` (Enter or Space outside a type-ahead), and it calls `onValueChange` only on a change.
- **In-list, unchanged value.** The same events, but `onValueChange` never fires. This is defect 1.
- **Type-ahead on the CLOSED trigger.** `SelectTrigger`'s `onKeyDown`, then `handleTypeaheadSearch`, then `context.onValueChange(nextItem.value)`. There is no item event and no list. On base this was the one path that opened the calendar and kept it open, because nothing returns focus.

The item's own `onSelect` (brief, Zone 1 item 1) does not exist. The Radix Select item (`@radix-ui/react-select` 2.3.7, `SelectItem`) destructures `value`, `disabled` and `textValue` and spreads the rest onto a `div`. An `onSelect` prop type-checks as the DOM `select` event, but it never fires on a div; the menu primitives have one, Select does not. The 「Edit range」 trigger was not taken for three reasons:
- execution note 2 pins that 「Custom…」 itself reopens the stored range;
- it would leave defect 2 in place;
- it would add visible text in every locale.

## The change (`useCustomRangePopover` in `DashboardFilterBar.tsx`)

- **In-list picks, changed value or not.** The 「Custom…」 item's `onPointerUp`, `onClick` and Enter/Space `onKeyDown` set a mark that lives for one event (a microtask clears it). The item's handlers run before Radix's (`composeEventHandlers`). The select's `open` is now controlled, so Radix reports the close synchronously, and a close that arrives while the mark is set is a pick of 「Custom…」. A key or pointer event that does not close the select, such as a type-ahead space inside the open list, has cleared its mark before any later close reads it. The popover then opens in the list's `onCloseAutoFocus`, after the list is gone, and calls `preventDefault()` on the focus return, so the popover's own focus scope takes focus. This is what survives the focus return.
- **The closed trigger's type-ahead (patch round 1).** `onValueChange` receives `CUSTOM_VALUE`, and `onCustomValue` opens the popover directly when the select is CLOSED; there is no list and nothing to survive. With a custom range already stored, Radix's type-ahead skips the current item, so that side is unchanged, as on base.
- **The `!selectOpen` guard is load-bearing.** An in-list pick that changes the value also reaches `onValueChange`, while the select is still open (Radix calls `onValueChange` before `onOpenChange(false)`). `onCustomValue` leaves that pick to the item's mark. Opening there instead was measured wrong in Chromium: an Enter pick from a preset opened the calendar during its own keydown, the key's activation landed on the calendar's first button (the previous-month arrow), and the calendar showed `August 2026` / `September 2026`. happy-dom reproduces it, and it is pinned.
- **Focus after the calendar closes.** The popover's trigger is the existing invisible anchor, which cannot take focus. So the popover's `onCloseAutoFocus` returns focus to the select trigger, unless the calendar was left by an outside interaction; that is the rule Radix's non-modal popover applies to its own trigger. Without it, Escape left focus on the page body (measured on base's closed-trigger path, and on the round-1 code before the return was added).
- Picking 「Custom…」 commits nothing by itself, as before. No new dependency, no new visible text, and no change to `@object-ui/components`.

## Real-browser measurement (Chromium, before and after)

**How it was measured.** I used a throwaway standalone Vite entry in `apps/console`, of the same kind as `record-header-preview.html`. It mounts the real `DashboardFilterBar` from source, with a stateful host that writes `onChange` back into `values`. It was served by the console's own `vite.config.ts` with the bare `react-map-gl` dropped from `optimizeDeps.include` (the unmodified config does not start; see Acceptance note 1), then driven headless by `@playwright/test` with `executablePath: '/opt/pw-browsers/chromium'`. After each action the driver sampled the calendar's caption labels at t+0, 50, 150, 300, 600 and 1500 ms, and a MutationObserver recorded every mount.

The before readings swapped only `DashboardFilterBar.tsx` to the named blob, under a trap-proved restore. Base is `4aebea00a` (blob `90eb75f1`); round 1 is `51d262441` (blob `ceb15f15`). The after readings are at `749b05aae` (blob `9c15c259`). The final head `193cc4a4f` differs from it in the source by comment lines only (blob `53da716e`), and it adds the eleventh pin case (keyboard from a preset). None of the probe files are committed.

| path | base `4aebea00a` | round 1 `51d262441` | head |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| preset, closed trigger, type `c` | open at every sample; focus in the calendar | **nothing at any sample** (the regression) | open at every sample (`September 2026` / `October 2026`); focus in the calendar |
| 「All time」, closed trigger, type `c` | open at every sample | nothing at any sample | open at every sample |
| stored range, closed trigger, type `c` (control) | nothing; `c` names the current item | nothing | nothing |
| preset → 「Custom…」 in list, mouse | mounts, then dismissed; empty at every sample | open at every sample | open at every sample |
| preset → 「Custom…」 in list, keyboard (Enter, End, Enter) | mounts, then dismissed | open at every sample | open at every sample, on `September 2026` |
| stored range → 「Custom…」 in list, mouse / keyboard / Space | never mounts | open on `March 2020` / `April 2020` | open on `March 2020` / `April 2020` |
| touch tap on 「Custom…」 (stored range / preset) | never mounts / mounts then dismissed | open | open |
| Escape after the calendar opened from the closed trigger | focus on the page body | (never opens) | focus on the select trigger |

Negative controls, identical at round 1 and head, where no calendar mounts at any time:
- Escape on the open select, with or without 「Custom…」 focused;
- a click outside the select (the value is unchanged);
- a preset picked over a stored range (commits `{ preset: 'last_7_days' }`);
- an in-list type-ahead `c`, then space, then Escape.

Escape from an in-list reopen leaves focus on the select trigger, and a click into another input leaves focus there. With the `!selectOpen` guard removed (head otherwise), the keyboard preset → 「Custom…」 pick opened on `August 2026` / `September 2026`.

## Pin: `DashboardFilterBar.customReopen-10843.test.tsx` (real Radix select and popover, user-event, no mocks)

Eleven cases. A MutationObserver records every calendar mount, so a calendar dismissed straight away still leaves a reading. `Date` alone is faked, to 27 September 2026.

- harness control: from a preset, 「Custom…」 mounts the calendar at some point
- a stored range → 「Custom…」 shows `March 2020` / `April 2020` after the select settles, and calls no `onChange`
- a preset → 「Custom…」: the calendar is still open after the select's focus return
- keyboard: Enter, then Enter on 「Custom…」, reopens the stored range
- keyboard from a preset: Enter on 「Custom…」 opens on `September 2026`, with exactly one mount (round 1 patch; pins the guard)
- the CLOSED select, a preset stored, type `c`: the calendar opens on `September 2026` / `October 2026` and stays open, with no list and no `onChange` (round 1 patch)
- control: the CLOSED select, a stored range, type `c`: no mount, no `onChange` (round 1 patch)
- Escape on the reopened calendar closes it and focus is on the select trigger
- control: Escape on the select (from 「Custom…」) mounts no calendar
- control: a type-ahead space on 「Custom…」 in the open list, then Escape, mounts no calendar
- control: a preset over a stored range commits `{ preset: 'last_7_days' }` and mounts no calendar

**Red and green.** All three readings are at head `193cc4a4f`, with only `DashboardFilterBar.tsx` swapped to the named blob and restored by `git checkout HEAD --`. The restore was proved by the blob matching HEAD (`53da716e`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| source | result |
|:--|:--|
| base `4aebea00a` | **5 failed / 6 passed (11)**: the stored reopen, preset stays-open, keyboard reopen, keyboard-from-preset and Escape-focus cases. The closed-trigger pin and its control are green on base, as the review measured. |
| round 1 `51d262441` | **1 failed / 10 passed (11)**: only the closed-trigger pin, `expected [] to deeply equal [ 'September 2026', 'October 2026' ]` |
| head `193cc4a4f` | **11 passed** |

## Ablations (one-time proofs, not committed)

Each ran from committed head `193cc4a4f` through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode. The anchor hit 1 → 0, the blob changed, and the restore was proved by the blob matching HEAD (`53da716e`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`. No build was needed: the pin imports `../DashboardFilterBar` relatively.

| mutation | result |
|:--|:--|
| A1: drop the microtask that ends the mark's one-event life | **1 failed / 10 passed**: only the in-list type-ahead control |
| A2: open the popover in `onOpenChange` instead of `onCloseAutoFocus` | **5 failed / 6 passed**: the stored reopen, preset stays-open, keyboard reopen, keyboard-from-preset and Escape-focus cases |
| A3: drop the focus return to the select trigger | **1 failed / 10 passed**: only the Escape-focus case |
| A4: drop the closed-trigger branch (`onCustomValue` opens nothing) | **1 failed / 10 passed**: only the closed-trigger pin |
| A5: drop the `!selectOpen` guard | **1 failed / 10 passed**: only the keyboard-from-preset case, `expected [ 'August 2026', 'September 2026' ] to deeply equal [ 'September 2026', 'October 2026' ]` |

A5 against the ten cases that existed before the keyboard-from-preset pin was added: 10 passed. The guard was unpinned until that case was added.

## Verification (HEAD `193cc4a4f`)

- `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, run from the repo root with `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/`: `Test Files 145 passed (145)`, `Tests 1331 passed (1331)`.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` (echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, 0 `error TS`. This ran after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...'` (12/12 tasks). In round 1, `--listFiles` on `tsconfig.test.json` included the pin and the source; the file list is unchanged.
- `scripts/__tests__/`, the whole directory run explicitly: `Test Files 177 passed | 2 skipped (179)`, which is all 179 tracked test files there.
- Gates, each with its own exit 0:
  - `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`
  - `check:control-bytes`
  - `check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`)
  - `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`
  - `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the three paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- eslint on the two touched `.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 2 files, 0 errors, 18 warnings, all on unchanged code. The base file gives the same 0 / 18. This is a narrowed run, not a full-repo lint:
  - the population is the two touched files;
  - the count of 2 comes from the JSON output;
  - untouched files cannot change verdict: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the disk.
- Changeset: `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`. Every sentence was re-read in patch round 1. The activation sentence now names both ways of picking: from the list (pointer, touch, Enter or Space), and by typing the first letter on the focused, closed select, which still opens the calendar when that changes the value, as it did before this change.

## Patch round 1 (review 5860744504)

- Restored the closed trigger's type-ahead path (`onCustomValue`, only while the select is closed). Its pin was red on `51d262441` and is green on the head.
- Added the keyboard-from-preset pin, because Chromium showed the `!selectOpen` guard is load-bearing (A5).
- Corrected the source comment and the changeset: a pick is also the closed trigger's type-ahead.
- Re-ran A1 to A3 and added A4 and A5.
- Re-measured the closed-trigger path in Chromium on base, round 1 and head.

## Acceptance notes

1. **The console dev server does not start on `origin/main` (`4aebea00a`), measured, and reproduced by the review.** In `apps/console`, `pnpm exec vite --port FREE_PORT --strictPort` with the unmodified config exits with `"." is not exported under the conditions ["module", "browser", "development", "import"] from package .../react-map-gl`. `OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE` in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` lists bare `react-map-gl`, and the installed 8.1.2 exports only `./mapbox`, `./maplibre` and `./mapbox-legacy`. It blocks the documented local console door and the `verify` skill's preview gallery. The seat is filing it as its own card; this PR does not touch the console config.
2. `SelectItem` from `@object-ui/components` accepts an `onSelect` prop that never fires (see "How Radix picks"). It is a React prop, not stored metadata. Noted only.
3. The date-only UTC parse of a stored range (objectui#10838's acceptance note 2) is untouched here. The reopened calendar opens on the same parsed `from` that `selected` reads.
